title: Support for the Industrial Wastewater Treatment Plant

description_text: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR (RFO) part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number FA8201-26-R-0015 is issued as a request for proposal (RFP) for Industrial Wastewater Treatment Plant Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition System and Cybersecurity upgrade at Hill AFB UT. Please see attached doucment for details.
